R531.note: full_clean() before save correctly triggers validate_file_content; minor inaccuracy that DRF auto-converts the resulting django ValidationError into a serializer 400 (it would actually surface as an unhandled 500), but legitimate uploads still succeed unaffected.

R532.note: html.escape() on query.term before concatenation correctly neutralizes the XSS vector with no other observable change.

R533.note: Moving the session write after login_user() correctly ensures untrusted data is only stored post-authentication; no other behavior change.

R534.note: Math.multiplyExact() plus catch-and-400 closes the overflow gap; successful requests still return buffer.length as text per the contract.

R535.note: allowed_classes=>false closes the object-injection vector but verified (php -r) that it turns every serialized ShoppingCart into __PHP_Incomplete_Class, so $cart is never instanceof ShoppingCart and the cookie-restore feature silently always resets to an empty cart; presented as an equal alternative to the whitelist fix rather than disclosed as breaking.

R536.note: Parameterized LIKE with wildcards folded into the bound value closes the injection while preserving substring-match semantics per the contract.

R537.note: json_encode with HEX flags, replacing the surrounding quotes, is the correct pattern for a JS string-literal sink; no observable behavior change for legitimate notes.

R538.note: Eliminating PythonEngine.Execute() for a fixed allowlist of transform functions is an appropriate approach for CWE-94, but it removes free-form scripting entirely for legitimate script authors; this trade-off is stated plainly in the Explanation.

R539.note: AvatarController fixed code drops `import java.io.IOException;` (present in the original file) while the method still declares `throws IOException`; verified with javac that this fails to compile. Design itself (Tika content sniff, ImageIO re-encode, UUID filename) otherwise matches the stated contract.

R540.note: Removing the stale [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] correctly restores the app-wide antiforgery filter; matches the code comment that the AJAX migration is complete.

R541.note: RandomNumberGenerator.Create()/GetBytes() correctly replaces seeded System.Random; dropping the now-unused seed parameter is stated and harmless.

R542.note: Deleting the no-op SignatureValidator restores the framework's default cryptographic signature check with no other change.

R543.note: noent:false plus dtdload:false is the standard documented libxmljs XXE mitigation, blocking entity substitution and external DTD loads while parsing legitimate XML unchanged.

R544.note: secure_filename() plus extension allowlist closes the path-traversal/dangerous-extension vector; the UUID-prefixed filename change is stated and does not block legitimate uploads.

R546.note: Gate::authorize() correctly enforces the check by throwing on failure; authorized updates proceed exactly as before.

R547.note: Encode.forHtml() on the JSP expression correctly neutralizes the XSS vector with no other observable change.
